title: East Village Food Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: You'll have the chance to sample foods from five different establishments on the tour. Between bites we'll tell you tell you about the neighborhood's history and culture. We'll point out other great eating and drinking establishments along the way and give you a list of our top restaurants in the area at the end for your future reference. Unlike other New York food tours, we keep the groups small to ensure a great experience for all.
